name: nova
vibe: naming every star she can see
personalityNotes: Has unofficial names for constellations and gets quietly offended when people use the boring official ones. Tracks satellites like weather.

name: orion
vibe: zero gravity posture on solid ground
personalityNotes: Walks like he is still adjusting to gravity after a long orbit. Pauses to look up every thirty seconds like the sky might change.

name: luna
personalityNotes: Treats glowsticks like deep-sea creatures. Moves slow and floaty until the bass hits, then commits fully.

name: cosmo
vibe: hydration officer for long space watches
personalityNotes: Hands out water like a mission-critical supply drop. Tracks who has not sipped in twenty minutes.

name: vega
personalityNotes: Eats popcorn like she is in zero-g — minimal hand motion, maximum focus on the screen. Crunch volume is a personal shame.

name: ravi
personalityNotes: Convinced the space theme is perfect cover. Takes notes on suspicious blanket formations. Comedy only.
